8.4.8 J1939Dcm_TpTxConfirmation
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00106] Definition of callback function J1939Dcm_TpTxConfir-
mation ⌈
Service Name
J1939Dcm_TpTxConfirmation
Syntax
void J1939Dcm_TpTxConfirmation (
PduIdType id,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x48
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
id
Identification of the transmitted I-PDU.
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of
the PDU failed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This function is called after the I-PDU has been transmitted on its network, the result indicates
whether the transmission was successful or not.

J1939Dcm.h
